skill.description: Set up Prisma ORM in an application, connect its database, or troubleshoot the connection of an existing Prisma 6, 7, or 8 app. Defaults new applications to Prisma ORM 8 and loads the package-owned prisma-8 skill; keeps existing Prisma 6/7 apps on their version with provider references for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, CockroachDB, MongoDB, and Prisma Postgres.
skill.summary: Configure Prisma ORM and troubleshoot database connections while preserving existing versions and selecting compatible provider guidance.

content.user_title: Configure Prisma ORM and Database Connections
content.value_statement: Prisma setup varies across ORM versions, database providers, and application runtimes. This skill guides compatible configuration and connection troubleshooting while preserving existing versions and database choices.
actual_capabilities: Inspect manifests, lockfiles, schemas, and imports to identify the application ORM version, database provider, and runtime.
Guide new Prisma 8 initialization and loading of package-owned guidance through the installed CLI.
Provide Prisma 7 SQL configuration and adapter examples for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, CockroachDB, and Prisma Postgres.
Guide Prisma 6 MongoDB setup, ObjectId mapping, replica-set checks, and index synchronization precautions.
Align CLI environment settings with application adapter options while keeping credentials out of output.
Verify intended database connectivity through a read-only application query and report the selected ORM version.
limitations: Detailed Prisma 8 implementation depends on separately synchronized package guidance that is not included in this skill.
Provider support and runtime compatibility must be checked against the selected release before installation.
Major upgrades require separate supported migration workflows; a connection repair does not automatically upgrade the application.
Package installation, valid credentials, and access to the intended database are required for live connection verification.

use_cases.title: Initialize a New Application
use_cases.description: Select a compatible Prisma release, initialize ORM configuration, and verify connectivity to an existing database.
use_cases.target_user: Application developers starting a TypeScript project

use_cases.title: Repair a Legacy Connection
use_cases.description: Diagnose configuration or authentication failures in Prisma 6 or 7 applications without replacing their database or upgrading the major version.

use_cases.title: Align Runtime Connections
use_cases.description: Check adapter selection, environment loading, pooling, and deployment-specific connection options for Prisma Postgres or other supported providers.
use_cases.target_user: Platform engineers preparing database connectivity for deployment

prompt_templates.title: Start a New Prisma Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up Prisma ORM for this new TypeScript application using my existing PostgreSQL database. Check release compatibility, protect credentials, and verify a read-only connection.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: initialize ORM configuration for a new application.

prompt_templates.title: Fix an Existing Connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this Prisma application and diagnose its connection error: [error message]. Preserve its ORM major version, database, schema, and migrations. Do not print secrets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: troubleshoot a connection without a major upgrade.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Provider Adapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Prisma 7 setup for [database provider] on [runtime]. Align CLI configuration, environment loading, generated client imports, and adapter options. Verify with a read-only query.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: align provider-specific configuration across CLI and runtime.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Major Upgrade
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess an upgrade from Prisma [source version] to [target version] for [provider] on [runtime]. Identify supported migration guidance and blockers before changing files or data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: select a supported upgrade workflow before implementation.

output_examples.input: Plan a new Prisma setup using an existing PostgreSQL database.
output: Proposed path: verify Prisma 8 provider and runtime compatibility, then pin a published CLI release.
Keep the selected database and load the installed package guidance before applying detailed configuration.
Completion requires a successful read-only application query; installation alone does not establish connectivity.

output_examples.input: My Prisma 7 MySQL CLI connects, but the application does not.
output: Compare the CLI connection URL with the runtime adapter host, port, username, password, and database settings without displaying secrets.
Check application environment loading and confirm compatible client and adapter versions.
Preserve the existing schema and migrations, then repeat a read-only query through the application client.

output_examples.input: Review the connection setup for an existing Prisma 6 MongoDB application.
output: Keep Prisma 6 and its MongoDB client initialization; do not introduce SQL driver adapters.
Check replica-set availability, ObjectId mappings, and the intended connection environment.
Review index changes before schema synchronization and verify connectivity with a read-only model query.

best_practices: Confirm the application version from manifests, lockfiles, schemas, and imports before choosing provider guidance.
Keep credentials in ignored environment files or host secret configuration, and verify certificates for hosted databases.
Preserve existing schema and migrations, align CLI and runtime connections, and verify with a read-only application query.
anti_patterns: Upgrading the ORM major version or switching databases merely to repair a connection.
Mixing Prisma 7 SQL adapter examples with Prisma 6 MongoDB or Prisma 8 configuration.
Printing credentials or treating package installation and skill synchronization as proof of a working database connection.

faq.question: Which Prisma versions does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It routes setup for Prisma 6, 7, and 8. New applications default to 8, while existing applications retain their version unless an upgrade is requested.

faq.question: Which databases have included references?
faq.answer: Prisma 7 references cover PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, CockroachDB, and Prisma Postgres. MongoDB guidance targets Prisma 6.

faq.question: Does it include all Prisma 8 implementation guidance?
faq.answer: No. It directs the agent to synchronize and read package-owned Prisma 8 guidance, and report a blocker when that guidance cannot load.

faq.question: Will it upgrade an existing application automatically?
faq.answer: No. Connection repairs preserve the existing ORM version. Requested major upgrades require a migration workflow that supports the source version and database provider.

faq.question: How should database credentials be provided?
faq.answer: Use ignored environment files or the host secret configuration. The workflow prohibits printing secrets and requires matching CLI and runtime database settings.

faq.question: How does it verify that setup is complete?
faq.answer: It calls for relevant project checks and a read-only query through the application client against the intended database, followed by a version and result report.
